connections.why: Knowing the muscular-skeletal system underpins analysing levers, planes and axes of movement
Components of fitness and training methods are grounded in how the body's systems respond to exercise
Principles and methods of training are applied directly when designing the personal fitness programme
Body-system knowledge explains and improves practical performance
Analysing movement helps refine technique in practical activities
Goal-setting, guidance and feedback shape how skills are learned and performed
Goal-setting and motivation theory inform planning and adherence to the fitness programme
Lifestyle choices and adherence connect to wider socio-cultural participation patterns
Analysis of personal performance feeds the evaluation in the fitness programme
Components of fitness such as power relate to how levers generate movement
